notes: Minus case: p=7547 gives a 29262-digit probable prime (Lifchitz, OEIS A088790), BPSW rechecked; none else to 230000. Plus case: no further prime p known (A088817: none below 4700). Outside Lean: everything (PRP computation in PARI/gp; primality of the 7547 number unproved).
